generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender document

technicalCriterionList.description: Last five years achieved at least in two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs. One time of Indent amount.

Satisfactoriy completed at least 50% of this contract as a Prime contractor of same works not less than 50% of Tender amount ( work done certificate for same work should be submitted which is issued by Deputy Conservator of Forests only).For Reserved Tenders Satisfactoriy completed at least 25% of this contract as a Prime contractor of same works not less than 25% of Tender amount ( work done certificate for same work should be submitted which is issued by Deputy Conservator of Forests only).
Each Tenderer should further demonstrate Availability of owning the following Key and critical equipment for this work.GPS and other Survey instruments And Soil excavator such as Hitachi/Jcb
Line of credit including E-tender Indent No & addressed to undersigned not less then 30% of the Tender amount received from any Nationalized Bank
Contractor should be registered as Forest Contractor in Karnataka Forest Department for the year 2026-27
Income tax returned filed documents for the last three financial year to be enclosed.
A copy of GST no registered under GST act.
Details of goods carriage vehicle, labor service, list of machineries & materials, equipments owned by the contractor.
For address proof any only copy of Adhar,PAN Card, Voter ID, Telephone bill within two months, Ration Card, Bank Pass book, ID issued any Corporation/TP to be uploaded).
A copy of List of Skilled, semi skilled, un skilled labours including EPF & ESI details to be uploaded) along with copy of Registration in Labour Department, EPF & ESI Registration Certificate
Caste Certificate Compulsory (for reserved category tenders)
Submission of Bid capacity (5 years Turnover) Amount of works contracted by contractors in all departments in the year 2026-27 (indent-wise) and turnover for the last five years

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Raising of Monsoon Plantation at Manikwadi FS No 19,20,21,22,23,26 (20 Ha) in Khanapur range khanapur sub division

itemList.description:
Survey and Demarcation of Planting Areas : Survey and
demarcation of plantation boundary lines after clearing
the rank growth to a width of 2 m. in the areas
width:-Thick under growth.

Aligning in the planting area along to the contours and
marking for pit (without staking)

Excavation of pits of size 0.60mtr x0.60xmtrx0.60 mtr with
vertically cut edges to make an uniform cube and heaping
the excavated soil (1/3rd top soil on the upper side and
2/3rd on the lower side) Ordinary soil (400 pits x0.60m31
pit=0.216 cum )

Refilling of pits, cutting of edge of the pit on the lower
side and refilling 75% or 100% of the pit as the case may
be with the excavated soil, duly breaking the clods &
arranging the remaining soil on the lower slope. 0.75 cum
= 42.19 cum x 0.75 x 100 = 31.64 cum

Loading of polythene bagged seedlings into the vehicle at
the nursery site and unloading at the site nearest to the
planting site including 10% casuality replacement.
Seedlings raised in 8”x12” size bags(in pits)

Transportation of polythene bagged seedlings in hired
truck from the nursery site to planting site. Seedlings
raised in 10”x16” size bags. Distance from 21 to 30 km.
(Considering the actual distance in the estimate)

Conveyance of polythene bagged seedlings on head load from
the dumping site to planting location near each
trench/pit. (Distance upto 3 km). 10”x16” size bagged
seedlings.

Watering polythene bagged seedlings at planting site by
dipping in water, including carrying of water. 10”x16”
size bagged seedlings

Planting of P.B. Seedlings after tearing with blade and
removing the polythene bags in trench / pits including
scooping the soil to required depth, pressing the soil
gently around the seedlings after planting. 10”x16” size
bagged seedlings
Purchase of NPK / DAP (25+25 =50 gms per plant) 2 times

Application of chemical fertilizer around the plants about
15 cm. away in a furrow duly covering with soil (excluding
the cost of fertilizer) in two equal split doses.

First weeding around the plants (pits) to a radius of 60
cm.

Scraping of grass and other weed growth around the plants
to a radius of 60 cm (Scraping item is allowed only in
grass infested areas.)

Hoeing & soil working with pickaxe around the plant to a
depth of 15cm. & to radius of 60 cm. so as to loosen the
soil around the plants.

Protection of plantation as per the standard norms from
01-07-2026 to 31-03-2027 for 274 days (for 25 ha. as a
unit during the year and pro-rata for different extent for
the actual period)

Fire Protection work in plantations: New Fire Lines:
Cutting of all existing weed growth to a width of 3 m.
heaping, burning and re-burning in younger plantations.

Providing & fixing plantation board (48"x27"x18" including
painting, writing, trasportation & fixing)

Raising of Seedlings 8*12 including10% Casuality
Replacement.

Maintainance Of Seedlings 8*12 till planting during 2026
rains

Raising of Seedlings 8*12 10% Casuality Replacement in
2027
Barbed wire fencing with wooden poles
Miscellaneous & rounding off smc Works
